# HA Web Studio

> Web design, development, SEO, performance, ecommerce, and custom web application studio.

Website: https://hawebstudio.com

## Content

- [Analytics & Tracking Implementation](https://hawebstudio.com/case-studies/analytics-tracking-implementation): How GA4, Microsoft Clarity, and custom event tracking were installed together as one measurement layer instead of three disconnected tools.
- [AWS Infrastructure Setup for a Media-Heavy SaaS Platform](https://hawebstudio.com/case-studies/aws-infrastructure-setup-cintegrate): How Cintegrate's backend was built around AWS S3 storage and a containerized deploy path from day one, instead of bolting cloud storage on after launch.
- [Cloudflare Deployment: Building a Secure, Fast, and Reliable Delivery Layer](https://hawebstudio.com/case-studies/cloudflare-deployment): How DNS, SSL, CDN, and caching were configured together as one edge delivery layer, instead of DNS records and a CDN toggle treated as separate afterthoughts.
- [CMS Integration: Building Flexible Content Management Systems for Modern Websites](https://hawebstudio.com/case-studies/cms-integration): How CMS choice — Sanity, Payload, or WordPress — is matched to a project's content complexity and technical requirements instead of defaulted to one platform for every build.
- [Email and DNS Infrastructure Foundation](https://hawebstudio.com/case-studies/email-dns-infrastructure-foundation): How HA Web Studio treats email and DNS reliability as part of a website build, not a separate handoff left for the client to figure out.
- [Google Business Visibility Foundation](https://hawebstudio.com/case-studies/google-business-visibility-foundation): How HA Web Studio pairs Google Business Profile setup with website architecture so local visibility and site content stay consistent.
- [HA Web Studio Platform Architecture](https://hawebstudio.com/case-studies/ha-web-studio-architecture): How HA Web Studio's own site evolved from a standard agency site into a connected system across Services, Work, Technologies, and Insights.
- [Payment Gateway Integration: Creating Secure, Reliable, and Frictionless Online Payment Experiences](https://hawebstudio.com/case-studies/payment-gateway-integration): How Razorpay and Stripe checkout flows are built around server-side signature verification and webhook handling, so payment confirmation never depends on trusting the client alone.
- [Technical SEO and AI Search Visibility Foundation](https://hawebstudio.com/case-studies/search-visibility-and-ai-search-foundation): How HA Web Studio built one connected foundation for technical SEO, structured data, and AI search visibility — not two separate efforts.
- [Website Performance Foundation with Next.js](https://hawebstudio.com/case-studies/website-performance-foundation): Internal case study on how HA Web Studio treats website performance as an architecture decision, not a one-off Core Web Vitals tuning pass.
- [AI Search Optimization: Preparing Your Website for AI-Powered Search](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/ai-search-optimization): Why websites need to be structured for AI systems like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and Perplexity — not just traditional search rankings.
- [Choosing the Right CMS: WordPress vs Sanity vs Payload CMS](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/choosing-the-right-cms): How CMS fit depends on your content, technical stack, and who's actually editing — not which platform is currently popular.
- [Cloudflare Explained: How a CDN Improves Website Speed, Security, and Reliability](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/cloudflare-explained): What Cloudflare actually does — DNS, CDN, SSL, caching, and security — and why unconfigured Cloudflare barely helps at all.
- [Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Turning More Visitors Into Customers](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/conversion-rate-optimization-guide): Why more traffic isn't the fix for a website that struggles to convert the visitors it already has — and what actually moves conversion rate.
- [Understanding DNS, Domains & SSL: A Practical Guide for Business Owners](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/dns-domains-ssl-guide): What actually happens between typing a domain and a page loading — domain, DNS, hosting, SSL, and CDN explained without the jargon.
- [Google Analytics 4: Measuring What Matters on Your Website](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/google-analytics-4): How GA4's event-based model works, what to actually track, and why it's more useful paired with qualitative tools like Microsoft Clarity.
- [Microsoft Clarity: Understanding How Visitors Actually Use Your Website](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/microsoft-clarity): How session recordings, heatmaps, and friction signals like rage clicks show what analytics numbers alone can't explain.
- [Choosing the Right Payment Gateway: Razorpay vs Stripe](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/razorpay-vs-stripe): How market and business model — not feature count — should decide between Razorpay and Stripe, illustrated through a real Razorpay integration.
- [Shopify vs WooCommerce: Which Ecommerce Platform Is Right for Your Business?](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/shopify-vs-woocommerce): How platform choice comes down to managed simplicity versus ownership and customization — not which one is more popular.
- [Structured Data & Schema: Helping Search Engines Understand Your Website](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/structured-data-schema): What Schema Markup is, the common types worth implementing, and how it supports both traditional search and AI interpretation.
- [Technical SEO Checklist for Every Business Website](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/technical-seo-checklist): A practical checklist for crawlability, indexability, structure, and metadata — the technical foundation every other SEO effort depends on.
- [Website Launch Checklist: What Every Business Should Do Before Going Live](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/website-launch-checklist): The technical, performance, SEO, analytics, and security review every website needs before launch — and what to monitor in the weeks after.
- [How to Plan a Successful Website Project: A Guide for Business Owners](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/website-project-planning-guide): Why website projects go over budget and past deadline — and the planning steps (goals, structure, content, SEO) that actually prevent it.
- [Website Security Basics: 10 Essentials Every Business Website Should Have](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/website-security-basics): The ten practical safeguards — HTTPS, strong auth, backups, monitoring — that prevent most real-world website security incidents.
- [Why Website Performance Matters for Business Growth](https://hawebstudio.com/insights/why-performance-matters): How Core Web Vitals impact your bottom line and SEO.
- [Customers Can't Find My Business](https://hawebstudio.com/problems/customers-cant-find-my-business): Your business isn't appearing in local search results, Google Maps, or location-based searches, making it difficult for nearby customers to discover your services.
- [Low Conversion Rate](https://hawebstudio.com/problems/low-conversion-rate): Visitors are reaching your website but leaving without enquiring, booking, or buying.
- [Need AI Features for My Business](https://hawebstudio.com/problems/need-ai-features): Your business wants to automate repetitive work, improve customer experience, or integrate AI into existing systems.
- [Need a Business Website](https://hawebstudio.com/problems/need-business-website): Your business needs a professional website that builds credibility, attracts customers, and supports long-term growth.
- [Need a Custom Web Application](https://hawebstudio.com/problems/need-custom-web-application): Your business has outgrown spreadsheets or off-the-shelf software and needs a solution designed around your workflow.
- [Need an Ecommerce Website](https://hawebstudio.com/problems/need-ecommerce-website): You want to start selling products online or upgrade your current online store with a secure, scalable ecommerce solution.
- [Need Third-Party Integrations](https://hawebstudio.com/problems/need-third-party-integrations): Your website needs to connect with payment gateways, CRM systems, booking platforms, email marketing tools, analytics, or other business software.
- [Need Website Maintenance & Support](https://hawebstudio.com/problems/need-website-maintenance): Your website is live, but it requires ongoing updates, monitoring, backups, security improvements, and technical support to remain reliable.
- [No Website Analytics & Tracking](https://hawebstudio.com/problems/no-website-analytics): Your website is live, but you have no reliable data to understand visitor behavior, marketing performance, or business results.
- [Not Showing Up on Google](https://hawebstudio.com/problems/not-showing-up-on-google): Your website exists, but potential customers can't find it through Google or other search engines.
- [Website Is Difficult to Update](https://hawebstudio.com/problems/website-difficult-to-update): Updating your website takes too much time, requires a developer for simple changes, or relies on an outdated content management system.
- [Website Is Slow](https://hawebstudio.com/problems/website-is-slow): Your website takes too long to load, creating a poor user experience and reducing conversions.
- [Need to Migrate My Website](https://hawebstudio.com/problems/website-migration): You're moving your website to a new platform, hosting provider, CMS, or developer and want to preserve performance, SEO, and business continuity.
- [Website Needs a Redesign](https://hawebstudio.com/problems/website-redesign): Your current website no longer reflects your business, performs poorly, or fails to convert visitors into customers.
- [Website Security Concerns](https://hawebstudio.com/problems/website-security-concerns): Your website may be vulnerable to attacks, malware, spam, or data breaches because security isn't being actively managed.
- [AI Search Visibility & Answer Engine Optimization](https://hawebstudio.com/services/ai-search-visibility-answer-engine-optimization): Content and structure optimization for AI retrieval and answer engine visibility.
- [Analytics & Tracking Setup](https://hawebstudio.com/services/analytics-tracking-setup): Tracking implementation for traffic, behavior, and conversion measurement.

- [Conversion Rate Optimization](https://hawebstudio.com/services/conversion-rate-optimization): Conversion-focused improvements to increase the value of existing traffic.

- [WooCommerce Development](https://hawebstudio.com/services/woocommerce-development): WooCommerce implementation for stores that need flexibility and deeper customization.
- [Chrome Extension APIs](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/chrome-extension-apis): Browser APIs for building extension-based functionality and workflow overlays.
- [Cloudflare](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/cloudflare): Edge platform for DNS, caching, and web traffic controls.
- [DNS](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/dns): Domain Name System configuration used for routing, verification, and infrastructure reliability.
- [Google Search Console](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/google-search-console): Search performance and indexing diagnostics platform for website visibility management.
- [Google Workspace](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/google-workspace): Business productivity and email platform used for domain-based communication workflows.
- [Judge0](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/judge0): Execution API for compiling and running code in multiple programming languages.
- [Next.js](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/nextjs): The React Framework for the Web.
- [Node.js](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/nodejs): JavaScript runtime used for servers, tooling, and API orchestration.
- [React](https://hawebstudio.com/technologies/react): A component-based library for building interactive user interfaces.
- [Cintegrate](https://hawebstudio.com/work/cintegrate): An AI-assisted video creation platform that turns a story idea into structured scenes, narration, and video output through one pipeline.
- [HA UI Design System](https://hawebstudio.com/work/ha-ui-design-system): Internal design system project focused on reusable components, consistency, and accessibility.
- [HA Web Studio Website](https://hawebstudio.com/work/ha-web-studio-website): The studio platform that powers HA Web Studio marketing, services, solutions, and publishing workflows.
- [MS Signature Scents](https://hawebstudio.com/work/ms-signature-scents): A full-stack ecommerce storefront for a fine attar fragrance brand, with a CMS-driven catalogue and Razorpay checkout.
- [Omnivy Web Clipper](https://hawebstudio.com/work/omnivy-web-clipper): A browser-first web clipper that turns any page into clean, editable Markdown and saves it into Obsidian, Notion, or your cloud drive.
